description: `cli package list ORG --help` prints the package list topic with usage, options, output schema and exit codes.

stdout.text:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli package list <ORG> [--cursor <CURSOR>] [--json]

List an organization's public packages, one page at a time. An organization with
no public packages prints `No public packages in ORG.` --output may also follow
the command.

Arguments:
  ORG                         Organization slug (see `cli org list`).

Options:
  --cursor CURSOR             The next-page cursor printed by the previous page.
  --json                      Print one JSON result; the same as the global --output json.
  --help                      Show help for this command.

Examples:
  prose cli package list acme --json

Output: openprose.package-operation/1 (--json).
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 invalid invocation or configuration; 10 service, credential or registry error; 24 interrupted.
